overview.implementation_summary: This integration branch adds a local GitHub pull request review workspace with pinned diffs and source, durable reviewer drafts, optional structured findings and diagrams, and a headless Bodh CLI. This qualification run focused on the native changed-file row presentation in the Changes view.

key_changes.summary: The native Changes view renders each changed file as a fixed-height, two-line row with horizontal inset and a selected state.

evidence.explanation: Pinned Head source sets the changed-file row to 48 px high, full width, and 8 px horizontal inset.

findings.title: Changed-file rows feel cramped in the native Changes panel
findings.summary: A prior native review reported that changed-file entries felt too close to the panel border and had an awkward amount of space between entries.
findings.reason: The pinned Head renderer uses 48 px fixed-height rows with 8 px horizontal inset inside a panel that also has 8 px padding. A user reported that this spacing made the changed-file list feel crowded at its edges and uneven between entries. The report is subjective and was made on a 947×1020 native window, so the severity and reproducibility remain uncertain.
findings.impact: The changed-file list is the primary navigation surface for large pull requests; uncomfortable spacing can make scanning and selecting files harder, especially when the list is dense.

evidence.explanation: This exact pinned range defines the row height and horizontal inset underlying the reported layout. The user's observation is recorded in contracts/v1/EVIDENCE-39.md; no source change is proposed from this single report.

examined_areas: Pinned native changed-file row height and horizontal spacing in spikes/native-sequence/src/product.rs
